summary: Frontend-only testing (local data mode) of two new features: Top 5 Jasa Terlaris chart in Dashboard and Preset Paket Jasa (bundle CRUD + picker integration). All 20 acceptance points from the review request PASSED. No blocking issues found.

design_issues.screen: RepairNew (pre-existing, not related to new features)
issues: React hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> for customer/brand selects (from visual-editing instrumentation attrs). Warning only, does not affect functionality. Reported for awareness.

critical_code_review_comments: ServicePicker.applyPackage silently returns when all items in a package were deleted (included.length===0). Consider showing a toast so users understand why nothing was added.
PackageModal accepts spread of `initial` which may include id/created_at fields; servicePackagesApi.update should ideally strip non-mutable fields (functional test passes).
seed_data_creation: Reset localStorage before test to load SEED_SERVICE_PACKAGES (3 seed paket).
